sentences.en: Our company has annual sales of a thousand million yen.
sentences.zh: 我们公司每年销售额达一千亿日元。

sentences.en: I took advantage of a sale and bought three sweaters.
sentences.zh: 我趁打折的时候买了三件毛衣。

sentences.en: Let's take advantage of the bargain sale and save money.
sentences.zh: 让我们利用特价销售的机会省钱吧。
